description: Logged integer differentials for Sol(5) amalgam-centralizer certificate fragment + Smith normal forms (replay with verify_snf.py).

d_outer_j0_a.role: outer differential at degree j=0 sector, collapsed zero complex after vanishing (lim^1=0 side)

d_outer_j0_b.role: outer differential at degree j=0 sector, collapsed zero complex after vanishing (lim^2=0 side)

d_D2.note: 1x1 minors generate unit ideal => invariant factors (1,1); sympy returns signed diag(-1,-1,0), unimodularly equivalent to diag(1,1,0)
